next_step: Finalize perf POC results; security questionnaire follow-up; procurement review
notes:
Account snapshot:
- Company: FjordBridge RAGWorks — internal developer platform for code search + contextual RAG used by multiple engineering orgs. Heavy focus on frequent re-indexing and low tail latency for dev queries.
- Decision makers: CTO (platform), Head of Search (evaluation owner), procurement starting to engage.
- Quote from 2026-02-12 call: 'We need sub-150ms p95 on developer code search or it's a non-starter; cost has to be predictable for 80M vector corpus.'

Technical requirements / constraints (short):
- Corpus: ~80M dense vectors (repo snapshots + historical artifacts), expected growth 2–4M vectors/week.
- Re-index cadence: incremental every 1–6 hours (high churn), full refreshs weekly. Must support online embeddings pipeline.
- Retrieval pattern: hybrid (sparse BM25 for recall + ANN for candidate retrieval) then cross-encoder rerank (top-50 -> cross-encoder).
- Latency targets: <=150ms p95 for ANN+rerank pipeline (they accept rerank as async if below 200ms but prefer sync).
- Throughput: spikes to 2k qps during engineering peak; baseline ~200 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.001/query end-to-end (embeddings + ANN + rerank amortized), prioritizes batching and quantized models.
- Models: prefer open variants; want ability to route to smaller embedding models for bulk recall and to higher-quality embedder for dev-facing flows.

POC / evaluation timeline (bulleted, CRM style):
- 2025-11-20: Intro demo (AE Aisha) — scoped ingestion options and residency.
- 2025-12-05: Security kickoff — sent initial security questionnaire (drive link).
- 2026-01-12: SE workshop with Liam to design pipelined indexing + cache strategy. Config notes: prefix caching for repo-level hot paths; incremental vector upserts.
- 2026-01-28: Baseline perf POC started — ingested 12M vectors (sample) into ANN index on Redwood Dedicated test cluster.
- 2026-02-08: First perf run: ANN recall 93% @ k=100, ANN latency 45ms avg, cross-encoder (rerank) 70ms avg on A100 quantized model. End-to-end avg ~140ms, p95 ~210ms (missed target). Cost approx $0.0016/query at current config.
- 2026-02-12: Architecture follow-up — evaluated options: move reranker to CPU-optimized low-latency path, increase batching window, or adopt Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantize reranker to int8).
- 2026-02-20: Security review: SAML/Okta tested, audit log schema approved pending retention SLA. Legal requested explicit IP retention clause.
- 2026-02-25: Internal procurement kickoff (estimated ARR conversation).

Key asks from customer (explicit):
- Hard SSO/SAML integration (Okta metadata + IdP-initiated flows).
- Proof of data residency: logs and datasets stored in customer VPC, no model training on customer data.
- Guidance on index sizing and autoscale for re-index bursts.
- Cost breakdown per component (embeddings generation, ANN search, rerank) per 100k queries.

Redwood fit / notes (AE/SE observations):
- Strengths: Redwood Dedicated + Private give clear path for VPC/on-prem requirement; Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization reduced predicted cost by ~35% in model.
- Risks: p95 tail still needs tuning. Reranker latency dominating; consider progressive rollout: cheap embedder for recall + async rerank for non-interactive tasks.
- Legal/security: pending clause on IP retention and explicit non-training guarantee in contract.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Liam) to run 2nd perf sweep with int8 reranker and increased cache TTL by 2026-03-07.
- Send updated security FAQ + signed SAML metadata by 2026-03-02.
- Procurement to provide draft SOW; AE to attach Redwood private pricing for 3-year commit.

notes_short: Evaluating Redwood Dedicated/Private for large-scale code RAG (80M vectors), strict SAML + data residency needs. POC shows close but p95 tail > target; reranker latency the main blocker.
